# The Story Shapers

> The Story Shapers (legal name: The Story Shapers Collective LLP) is a senior-led marketing collective in India. It was founded by Fatema Hanif, Shaili Contractor and Aakanksha Singh Devi, who have 17 to 20 years of experience each at brands and platforms including Headout, LBB (Little Black Book), Leo Burnett, Coca-Cola, Cadbury and the Singapore Tourism Board. The collective works with founder-led and growing brands on brand strategy and positioning, content and editorial, websites, SEO and AEO content, go-to-market and fractional content leadership. Clients work directly with the senior people who do the work. The Story Shapers also writes and makes memoirs, family histories and company books.

Key facts:

- Name: The Story Shapers, also written The Story Shapers Collective. Not related to other organisations, podcasts or books called "Story Shapers".
- Legal entity: The Story Shapers Collective LLP, LLPIN ACW-3552, registered in Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India. Co-founder Fatema Hanif runs the collective from Kolkata. The collective works with clients across India and internationally.
- Founders: Fatema Hanif (brand strategy, content architecture, go-to-market; 20 years), Shaili Contractor (brand, content and editorial strategy; trained journalist; 18 years), Aakanksha Singh Devi (content strategy, editorial operations, SEO; 17 years).
- How the collective works: clients work directly with the founders, alongside specialists in copy, growth marketing, design and social, as one team.
- Published price, website: ₹80,000 all in for a brand website of up to five pages, including strategy, copywriting, design and build, live in 10 working days once the client's assets are received. ₹25,000 books the slot and the ₹55,000 balance is due on completion.
- Published price, diagnostic: a 45-minute Brand Audit Call with Fatema Hanif or Aakanksha Singh Devi costs ₹5,000 and covers what is working, what is not, and what to fix first.
- Other ways to engage: a free introductory call; a strategy sprint of two to six weeks, scoped to one problem; a fractional partnership, priced monthly.
- Selected results: Headout, 10× the content output with the same size team; Centre Court Pickleball League (Bengaluru), 10,000+ people across six match weekends; LBB, a platform used by 60M+ people a month; Art Fervour, sponsor pitch success from 12% to 34%.
- Contact: hello@storyshaperscollective.com · WhatsApp +91 91477 40521

## Services

- [Services](https://www.storyshaperscollective.com/services): the full catalogue. Brand strategy and positioning, naming and brand voice; websites, blogs, newsletters and social; SEO, AEO and GEO content; growth and performance marketing; thought leadership, content systems and fractional content leadership
- [The website offer](https://www.storyshaperscollective.com/offer): a brand website of up to five pages for ₹80,000 all in, live in 10 working days, with answers to common questions
- [Website offer terms](https://www.storyshaperscollective.com/offer/terms): scope, payment, revisions and cancellation in full
- [Books](https://www.storyshaperscollective.com/books): memoirs, biographies, family histories, company histories, family photo books and coffee table books, from a 16-page keepsake zine to a 240-page cloth-bound book, with the process and answers to common questions
